fixes.problem: Mission-level BLOCKED was terminalized into queue history, preventing later autonomous retry after the underlying blocker was fixed.
fixes.invariant: BLOCKED is temporary queue parking with a bounded retry timestamp; DONE remains terminal history, while non-retryable audit/integrity failure is terminal FAILED.

fixes.problem: The mission queue was stored only under a Chrome window-id key, so a recreated browser window could not recover the prior queue after restart/update.
fixes.invariant: A profile-local durable queue registry preserves the stable queue identity and may rebind only queues whose former bound window is no longer live; in-flight ACTIVE work is restored as READY and completed history remains terminal.

fixes.problem: Saving Grundparametrar för uppdragskö rendered stored/default settings back into the form before the edited control values were read, so the old values were resubmitted.
fixes.invariant: Capture the operator form patch before busy-state rendering, persist it through the existing profile-local operator-settings contract, and use storage readback as the saved value.

preservedContracts: AUDIT_FAILURE is terminal FAILED and disables queue progression
operator settings remain profile-local chrome.storage.local state
